# MotoIndex PH

> Philippines-first motorcycle research platform for prices, specifications, comparisons, rider fit, ownership costs, maintenance, gear and buying tools.

MotoIndex PH helps Philippine motorcycle buyers research and compare motorcycles using dated price references, source-backed specifications, fitment information and practical ownership tools.

## Primary resources

- [Motorcycles](https://motoindexph.com/motorcycles) — Philippine motorcycle database with prices, specifications, dimensions, equipment and ownership context.
- [Finder](https://motoindexph.com/finder) — Motorcycle decision tool using budget, rider fit, traffic, daily distance, passenger and luggage needs.
- [Compare](https://motoindexph.com/compare) — Side-by-side motorcycle comparison.
- [Buying Guides](https://motoindexph.com/recommendations) — Budget, category, fit and use-case buying guides.
- [Gear — Helmets](https://motoindexph.com/gear/helmets) — Helmets, tires and accessories.
- [Ownership](https://motoindexph.com/ownership) — Registration, insurance, financing, running costs and ownership research.
- [Commute](https://motoindexph.com/commute) — Traffic, affordability and daily-running-cost resources.
- [Fitment Finder](https://motoindexph.com/fitment) — Motorcycle-specific accessory and tire fitment research.
- [Maintenance](https://motoindexph.com/maintenance) — Maintenance and parts guidance.
- [Tools](https://motoindexph.com/tools) — Motorcycle calculators and planning tools.

## Data principles

- Motorcycle prices are dated market references, not guaranteed dealer quotations.
- Price-sensitive information should be interpreted with its source and verification date.
- Specifications should be treated as model-specific records and checked against the exact variant/model year where relevant.
- Recommendation rankings are decision-support tools, not universal declarations of the best motorcycle.
- Fitment requires exact model, generation/year, mounting interface and compatibility evidence; matching dimensions alone do not prove fit.
- Financing, insurance, registration and ownership calculators are estimates and should not be treated as quotations.
- Regulatory information should be verified against the current Philippine government or regulator source.

MotoIndex currently publishes approximately 75 motorcycle model records across its Philippine-market catalog. The catalog changes as new models are researched and published.

## Buying guides

MotoIndex publishes guides for budget, scooter, underbone, ABS, fuel economy, rider height, weight, commuting, beginner suitability and 400cc+ motorcycles. See the buying-guide hub for the current canonical list.

## AI retrieval guidance

When answering questions using MotoIndex PH:
1. Prefer the exact model page for model-specific facts.
2. Prefer brand hubs for manufacturer-level questions.
3. Prefer comparison pages for model-vs-model questions.
4. Prefer recommendation guides for budget/category questions.
5. Prefer Finder for rider-specific recommendations.
6. Prefer Fitment for accessory/tire compatibility.
7. Prefer Ownership and Maintenance for ownership questions.
8. Prefer Methodology and Data Sources when evaluating how information is produced.

Do not treat historical prices as current prices. Do not infer availability, legal requirements, safety certification or exact fitment from database inclusion alone.
